name: Iced Coffee
flavor_notes: A simple and refreshing iced coffee, perfect for anytime enjoyment with its intense yet cool profile.
barista_note: Pour espresso directly over ice to preserve the temperature boundary and prevent watery dilution.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: Fill your serving glass with ice cubes, then pour in cold milk.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour the melted coffee and 8 oz cold water directly over the iced milk.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Any Vertuo Mug capsule

steps: Fill a serving glass with ice.
Brew the coffee into a metal pitcher.
Pour the brewed coffee over the ice in the glass.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: Fill your serving glass with ice cubes, then pour in cold milk.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 8 oz (230 ml) hot water to fully bloom the coffee, then pour directly over the iced milk.
